verified_fact: During Samudra Manthan (churning of the ocean), Mount Mandara was used as the churning rod but kept sinking. Vishnu took the Kurma (turtle) avatar and served as the base, holding Mandara on his back in the ocean.
voiceover_script: Samudra Manthan ke liye Mandara parvat ko churning rod banaya. Par parvat samandar mein doobne laga! Tab Vishnu ne liya Kurma avatar — virat kachua bana! Mandara parvat ko apni peeth par tika liya. Devas aur Asuras dono taraf se manthan karte rahe — Vishnu neeche kachua bane baitha raha. Is tyaag ke bina amrit nahi milta. Pura Samudra Manthan Vishnu ki peeth par tika tha!

description:
Kurma Avatar: Kachua Bana Vishnu! 🐢

🔱 Vishnu Kurma turtle avatar Samudra Manthan base support

During Samudra Manthan (churning of the ocean), Mount Mandara was used as the churning rod but kept sinking. Vishnu took the Kurma (turtle) avatar and served as the base, holding Mandara on his back in the ocean.

👉 Aise neta hote hain jo khud neeche rahe aur doosron ko utha rakhe!
